    <div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 12pt; font-weight: bold;">Item 1.&#160; Description of Registrant&#8217;s Securities to be Registered.</div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt; font-size: 12pt;">Orange County Bancorp, Inc. (the &#8220;Registrant&#8221;) hereby incorporates by reference the description of its common stock, $0.50 par value per
      share, to be registered hereunder contained under the heading &#8220;Description of Capital Stock&#8221; in the Registrant&#8217;s <a href="https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001754226/000110465921090389/tm2116829-3_s1.htm">Registration Statement on Form S-1</a>
      (No. 333-257781) as originally filed publicly with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;Commission&#8221;) on July 9, 2021, as subsequently amended on <a href="https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001754226/000110465921094974/tm2116829-6_s1a.htm">July 22, 2021</a> and <a href="https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001754226/000110465921097270/tm2116829-9_s1a.htm">July 29, 2021</a> (the
      &#8220;Registration Statement&#8221;), and in the prospectus, included in the Registration Statement to be filed separately by the Registrant with the Commission pursuant to Rule 424(b) under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, which prospectus will be
      deemed to be incorporated by reference herein.</div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 12pt; font-weight: bold;">Item 2.&#160; Exhibits.</div>
    <div><br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; font-size: 12pt;">In accordance with the &#8220;Instructions as to Exhibits&#8221; for Form 8-A, no exhibits are required to be filed because no other securities of the
      Registrant are registered on the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC, and the securities registered hereby are not being registered pursuant to Section 12(g) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended.</div>
